CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) and an explicit origin/status (completed_record) are present for the same referent/time, providing content, organization/presentation and a separate status marker.

A.rationale: No statement links an attention/allocation condition to the organization/presentation/access of the same content.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies represented contents (coloured positions) and their attributes (red/blue) for specific referents and times.

D.rationale: An explicit origin/status (completed_record) is attributed to the identified content, separating content identity from its presentation/status.

O.rationale: The text specifies how content is presented (grid orientation) and gives origin/representation metadata describing presentation for named referents.
